_comment: Point your MCP client at Clearwake instead of PayPal. Default backend: the local provider, nothing real to move. For the sandbox backend add --backend paypal to args and set CLEARWAKE_SANDBOX_ACK=I_CONFIRM_SANDBOX_ONLY, PAYPAL_ENVIRONMENT=SANDBOX and a sandbox PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.
claude_code: claude mcp add paypal-guarded -- python -m clearwake.mcp_server
